draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.37, the 35th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 7th of 34 at WR. He went 33rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: A.J. Green. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (19th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (4th percentile). College production: 1,167 receiving yards in 2019, 12th of 34 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 85 career games and 76 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 7 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: receiving td 11 (99th percentile), drop rate 2.0% (86th percentile), receiving yards 846 (80th percentile). Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 2.8 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 wide receiver who played: 846 receiving yards against a median of 502, above the norm.
